fields.Name: T48 - Entity Form View Member
fields.Description: Verifies that a Member record opens into its full editable entity form with populated fields, confirming the form rendering pipeline works for the Members entity.

InputDefinition.goal: IMPORTANT: To open the 'Members' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box — type 'Members' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Members' (individual member people, ~2000 records; NOT 'Board Members', 'Campaign Members', 'Member Follows', 'Memberships', 'Membership Types', 'Chapter Memberships', or 'Committee Memberships'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Navigate to Data Explorer and open the 'Members' entity from the entity tree. Click a member row in the grid (e.g. Sarah Chen), then click the 'Open Full Record' button to load the full editable member form in a tab. Reach the state where the form is fully rendered with populated fields such as the member's name and email. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full Members record form is displayed in a tab, not just the grid preview panel
Form fields show populated member data such as a name and an email address
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
